title: Grilled Norwegian Salmon with Smoky Cheese Crust
description: A smoky twist on the classic Norwegian salmon dish. The smoky cheese crust adds a depth of flavor and a nice char to the salmon.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix together smoked cheese, breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt.
Dip each salmon fillet in the beaten egg and then coat in the cheese mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated salmon fillets on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove from grill and serve with a squeeze of lemon and a side of your choice.
